description: Execute raw W3C Actions API sequences for advanced multi-touch gestures not covered by appium_gesture. Use this for custom multi-finger gestures (rotate, three-finger swipe, edge swipes), complex timing sequences, or any gesture requiring precise control over individual touch points. Prefer appium_gesture for standard gestures (tap, scroll, swipe, pinch) — it handles platform differences automatically.

actions.description: W3C Actions API input source array. Each entry is one input source (pointer/key/none) with its action sequence. Multiple pointer sources enable multi-touch gestures (e.g. two-finger rotate, three-finger swipe). All sources execute in parallel, synchronized tick-by-tick.
Ordered list of action steps for this input source.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. Required for pause and pointerMove.

origin.description: Coordinate origin: "viewport" (default) or "pointer" (relative to current position).

id.description: Unique identifier for this input source (e.g. "finger1", "finger2").

pointerType.description: Pointer type. Use "touch" for mobile gestures. Only for type=pointer.

type.description: Input source type. pointer = touch/mouse, key = keyboard, none = pause/timing.

sessionId.description: Session ID; defaults to the active session.

name: appium_perform_actions
